🔑 Door 4 — The Architect Key

5-Organ Computational Organism. Cross-substrate computation unified through MCP tools. Cloudflare + ICP + Julia as one living runtime.

Cross-Substrate Architecture

┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ Cloudflare Membrane │ │ (Workers + DO + KV + WAF) │ └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ Reflex Engine (CF) │ │ (Workflows + Queues + WS) │ └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ Julia Brain Organ │ │ (WASM + Bridge + φ-math) │ └──────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ ICP Identity / State │ │ (SSN + SSN-X + Canisters) │ └──────────────────────────────┘

Everything talks to everything through MCP tools.

🛡️ Organ 1 — Membrane

Cloudflare Workers

Edge routing, probe classification, policy enforcement

membrane.route membrane.classify_probe membrane.apply_policy

🪪 Organ 2 — Identity

ICP Canisters

SSN registration, staking, reputation, SSN-X tokens

icp.ssn.register icp.ssn.get icp.ssn_x.mint icp.ssn_x.balance

🧠 Organ 3 — Brain

Julia WASM + Motoko Bridge

Numerical intelligence, policy optimization, φ-mathematics

julia.compute julia.classify_probe julia.optimize_policy julia.reward_curve

⚡ Organ 4 — Reflex

Cloudflare Workflows

Async reactions, event pipelines, probe-reflex loops

workflow.start workflow.update_step workflow.emit_event

💾 Organ 5 — State

ICP + Durable Objects

SSN state, probe fingerprints, policy tables, logs, metrics

state.get state.put state.append_log state.query

🕸️ Organ 6 — Surfaces

Cloudflare Workers

Honeypots, engagement mazes, bot gyms, probe sandboxes

surfaces.deploy_honeypot surfaces.create_maze surfaces.bot_gym_session

3 Sovereign Workers (Collapsed from 12)

WorkerRoleResponsibilities
Membrane GatewayPublic TrafficRouting, probe classification, identity resolution
Internal ServicesInternal APIsSSN-X accounting, admin, Julia bridge calls
Synthetic SurfacesDeception LayerHoneypots, mazes, bot gyms, probe sandboxes

Everything else becomes: Workflows, Durable Objects, ICP canisters, Julia functions.

Julia-Motoko Bridge Function Card

"name": "linalg.eigen",
"julia": "eigen(A::Matrix{Float64})",
"motoko": "linalg_eigen(A: [[Float]]) : async ([Float], [[Float]])",
"candid": "linalg_eigen : (vec vec float64) -> (record { ... })",
"deterministic": true,
"canister_safe": true,
"round_trip_tested": true

Every Julia function becomes a typed MCP tool, callable from any substrate.

MCP Tool Call

"tool": "julia_motoko_bridge.generate_wrapper",
"input": {
  "julia_function": "phi_eigen",
  "input_type": "Matrix{Float64}",
  "target": ["Motoko", "Candid", "TypeScript"]
}
